# writeonly_hash (Resource)

Accepts an ephemeral input and returns a hash of the input as a non-ephemeral output.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "some_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "writeonly_hash" "some_secret" {
  input_wo = var.some_secret
}

resource "time_static" "secret_update_timestamp" {
  triggers = {
    value = writeonly_hash.some_secret.output
  }
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "some_secret" {
  secret_id                = "some_secret"
  secret_string_wo         = var.some_secret
  secret_string_wo_version = time_static.secret_update_timestamp.unix
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `input_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only input (not stored in state). The resulting hash is stored in `output` and `id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Returns sha256 hash of `input_wo`.
- `output` (String) Returns sha256 hash of `input_wo`.
